content.prompt: A fitness centre has purchased a rowing machine for $\$3900$. The machine depreciates according to the declining-balance method at 15% p.a.

inlines.text: Complete the table then sketch the graph. Round the table values to the nearest cent.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Explain why the graph is not a straight line.

answer.short: The value decreases by a constant percentage, so the dollar loss decreases each year. The graph shows exponential decay.
answer.worked: Each year the machine loses 15% of its remaining value. As the value falls, the dollar amount lost each year becomes smaller. A straight-line graph would require a constant dollar change, so this graph is curved.
